decided.point: Take it up: at least lint every migration for long-locking operations and give migrations a lock timeout.
decided.detail: Rehearsing on a copy of production is dropped or replaced by a production-size synthetic or anonymised dataset, because of patron data; expand-then-contract may also be taken.

why.point: Two outages this year (May and September 2026) came from migrations that locked tables during opening hours, and nothing checks migrations today, because tests run them on an empty database.
why.detail: Independent reports found most migration outages come from statements a static check flags.

next.point: The work is handed on: add a migration lint and a lock timeout to the checks (bin/check or CI) so a lock-taking migration fails before it is deployed.
next.detail: With a way to tell whether it worked, such as no more migration-caused lock incidents.
